ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 95 percent of the visible surface consists of low-intensity (dark) pixels with sparse high-intensity (white/yellow) localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark-gray/black contiguous field across both visible lobes, interspersed with high-contrast, small circular high-intensity centroids (yellow-white) representing focal points of colonization.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitudes visible along the dorsal-facing boundary of both lobes; edges appear jagged and uneven against the sky/water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves sweeping upward and outward from the water line toward sharpened distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense population of approximately 40-50 localized circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white/yellow) distributed across the ventral surface, with heavy aggregation at the distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel light-gray linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed on the mid-section of both the left and right lobes, oriented at approximately 45-60 degree angles relative to the horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral accumulation of biological matter (barnacles) creating a secondary textured topography on the distal tips and trailing edges.
